name: Hobbywing QuicRun brushed 540-30T 1/10 motor
uncertainty: Hobbywing publishes O.D. 36 mm, length 53.2 mm, shaft 3.175 mm, 168 g for the 540-30T. Mount tab geometry (21 mm pitch, M3) follows the standard 540 pattern used across RC brushed motors and is not a Hobbywing drawing value.
material: Steel can, plastic endbell, armature with copper windings

features.kv_source: Derived from the published no-load figure of 14000 rpm at 12.6 V (14000/12.6 = 1111 rpm/V). Treat as +/-10 percent; the SI torque constant is 9.55/Kv.
features.armature_inertia_source: Typical published armature inertia for a 540-size 30T brushed motor is 1.0e-5 to 1.2e-5 kg m^2; 1.08e-5 used, flagged as uncertain.
features.winding_resistance_source: Not published by Hobbywing; estimated from a 540 30T 7.4 V motor measuring ~0.1-0.15 ohm end to end. Uncertain.
